base_setup_commands: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git curl pkg-config libssl-dev ca-certificates

runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: cargo test handles its own dependency resolution
runtime_profile.notes: Rust toolchain pre-installed in rust:1.70-slim-bookworm base image. Script detects existing rustc >= 1.70.0 and skips rustup. Cargo and rustc are already in PATH. Activation sources rustup env only when rustup was installed.

notes: Base image rust:1.70-slim-bookworm has Rust 1.70 pre-installed without rustup. The setup_runtime.sh script now detects pre-existing rustc >= 1.70.0 and uses it directly, skipping rustup installation. Activation command includes '|| true' to handle cases where rustup env file doesn't exist (pre-installed Rust scenario). Git and curl are included in system packages.
